# Psalm 72 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-Solomon. O-God your-judgments to-the-king give, and-your-righteousness to-son-of the-king.

**2** May-he-judge your-people with-righteousness, and-your-afflicted-ones with-justice.

**3** May-bear the-mountains peace to-the-people, and-the-hills in-righteousness.

**4** May-he-judge the-afflicted-of the-people, may-he-save the-children-of the-needy, and-may-he-crush the-oppressor.

**5** May-they-fear-you with the-sun, and-before the-moon generation-of generations.

**6** May-he-come-down like-rain upon mown-grass, like-showers watering the-earth.

**7** May-flourish in-his-days the-righteous, and-abundance-of peace until is-no-more the-moon.

**8** And-may-he-rule from-sea to-sea, and-from the-River to-ends-of the-earth.

**9** Before-him may-bow desert-dwellers, and-his-enemies the-dust may-they-lick.

**10** Kings-of Tarshish and-the-islands tribute may-they-bring; kings-of Sheba and-Seba gifts may-they-offer.

**11** And-may-bow-down to-him all kings; all nations may-they-serve-him.

**12** For he-will-deliver the-needy crying-out, and-the-afflicted and-him-who-has no helper.

**13** He-will-have-pity on-the-poor and-the-needy, and-the-lives-of the-needy he-will-save.

**14** From-oppression and-from-violence he-will-redeem their-life, and-precious their-blood in-his-eyes.

**15** And-may-he-live, and-may-be-given to-him from-gold-of Sheba; and-may-he-pray for-him continually, all the-day may-he-bless-him.

**16** May-there-be abundance-of grain in-the-land on-top-of the-mountains; may-its-fruit rustle like-Lebanon, and-may-they-flourish from-the-city like-grass-of the-earth.

**17** May-be his-name to-forever; before the-sun may-his-name propagate; and-may-they-bless-themselves in-him, all nations may-they-call-him-blessed.

**18** Blessed YHWH God, God-of Israel, doer-of wonders he-alone.

**19** And-blessed name-of his-glory to-forever, and-may-be-filled his-glory all the-earth. Amen and-Amen.

**20** Are-ended the-prayers-of David son-of Jesse.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **72:1**: Lamed-inscription lishlomoh — traditionally 'of Solomon' but possibly 'for Solomon' (a Davidic prayer for his son).

- **72:8**: 'From-sea to-sea' and 'from the-River' (Euphrates) — cosmic scope echoing covenant promises to Abraham.

- **72:17**: Hebrew yinnon ('may-propagate') is a rare verb; some rabbinic tradition sees it as a messianic name.

— EMET
